title: Aries: love gets lighter
on December 5
summary: Rahu and Ketu, the north and south nodes, change signs on December 5. What eases for an Aries Moon that day, what wakes up at work and at home, and how to use the next year and a half.

inside: What Rahu and Ketu, the north and south nodes, are
What eases for you on December 5 and what begins
How to use the eighteen months that follow, step by step
intro: If you are an Aries by Moon sign, love and fun may have felt strangely far away for the last year and a half. Not gone, just harder to feel. Romance, play, the things you make for the joy of it: you may have shrugged at them more than usual. On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the two points in the sky that the tradition links to that feeling both change sign at the same moment.

This guide explains what those two points are, what moves out of your love life that day, what moves into your work and your home, and how long it lasts. Nothing here is a promise. It is what Vedic astrology reads from the sky by your Moon sign, and how to use it well.

sections.label: The two nodes
title: A head that wants,
a tail that lets go.
paragraphs: Rahu and Ketu are not planets you can see. They are the two points where the Moon's path crosses the Sun's path, which is why Western astrology calls them the north node and the south node of the Moon. Rahu is the north node and Ketu is the south node. They always sit exactly opposite each other, and they always change sign together.

The tradition pictures them as a dragon cut in two. Rahu is the head with no body: all appetite, always wanting more, never quite full. Wherever he sits, life is read as louder, hungrier and more ambitious. Ketu is the tail with no head: he does not crave and does not chase. Wherever he sits, you are said to loosen your grip and care less.

They spend about a year and a half in each sign, so a change of sign is one of the bigger turns of the calendar. For each Moon sign it moves the appetite to one part of life and the letting go to the opposite part. For Aries, the move on December 5 is a big one: the appetite lands on your career, and the letting go lands on your home.

sections.label: What eases
title: Love stops feeling
far away.
paragraphs: Since May 18, 2025, Ketu has been in your house of romance, the fifth house counted from your Moon sign. That house covers love affairs, dating, fun, children, creative work and anything you do for pure joy. With the calm, detached tail sitting in it, the tradition reads a stretch where those things feel a little muted. You might have wondered why a date felt flat, or why a hobby you loved stopped pulling at you.

Over the same months Rahu sat in your house of friends and gains, the eleventh house. That is read as a hunger for new circles, new contacts and bigger wins, often with a restless sense that the next group or the next opportunity would be the one.

On December 5 both leave. The tradition does not say romance arrives on a fixed day, but the particular feeling of being one step removed from your own love life is read as lifting from then. If the last year and a half taught you to be choosier about who and what deserves your heart, you keep that.

sections.label: What begins
title: The big goal,
and a calmer home.
paragraphs: Rahu moves into your house of career, the tenth house from your Moon sign. That house covers your work, your reputation, your standing in the world and the role you play in public. With the hungry head in it, this is read as a strong wish to rise: the bigger title, the bolder project, the job that people notice. Aries already likes to go first, so this placement is read as turning up the volume on an ambition you already have. Its useful side is drive. Its catch is impatience, and taking on more than one person can carry.

At the same moment Ketu arrives in your house of home, the fourth house. This is the letting go landing on your private life: your rooms, your family routines, your sense of roots. It is read as wanting a quieter, simpler space and caring less about keeping up appearances at home. Some people clear out clutter; some feel a little restless where they live. The useful side is real: a home with less noise in it is a better place to rest after a loud working day.
Put together, the next chapter is about balance. Chase the big goal out in the world, and keep one place where you do not have to chase anything.

rows.note: Ketu entered your house of romance and Rahu your house of friends and gains.
A Saturday. Rahu enters your house of career and Ketu your house of home, at the same moment.
Read as a time when work and ambition take centre stage and home becomes the place you go to recover.
Both move on again, and this chapter closes.

steps.name: Name the one goal
steps.text: The appetite for more can scatter you across five ambitions at once. Write down the one role or project you want most by the middle of 2028, and let it decide what you say yes to.

steps.name: Build it step by step
steps.text: This chapter rewards effort you can show. Take the stretch assignment, learn the skill, put your hand up. Pace it, so the hunger does not turn into burning out by spring.

steps.name: Make home the calm room
steps.text: Clear one corner, keep one evening a week free of plans, or simply turn work off at the door. The wish for a simpler space is part of this period, so give it something to work with.

steps.name: Say yes to fun again
steps.text: With the detached tail gone from your house of romance, try the date, the class or the creative thing you have been putting off. Notice whether it feels lighter than it did last year.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: Are Rahu and Ketu the same as the north and south node?
faq.a: Yes. Rahu is the Moon's north node and Ketu is its south node. Vedic astrology uses the sidereal zodiac, so the sign they are in can differ from the one a Western chart shows.

faq.q: Does this mean I will get a promotion after December 5?
faq.a: No one can promise that. The tradition reads these eighteen months as a time when ambition and career matter more to you and effort at work is easier to see. What you do with it, and your own birth chart, decide the rest.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
